settings.headline: About Harlow Creek Health System
settings.subtitle: A fictional not-for-profit regional health system built to show what a hospital website looks like on Raytha.

settings.headline: Hospital, clinics and specialty care under one system
settings.body:
In this story, Harlow Creek Medical Center opened in 1974. Today the system includes a Level II trauma center, a birth center, specialty pavilions for heart and cancer care, an orthopedic institute, urgent care in Millhaven and primary care in Ashford Crossing.

See locations · Services · News · Careers

items.a: No. Harlow Creek Health System is fictional. It was made up to show what a health system website built with Raytha can look like.

items.q: Can I book an appointment here?
items.a: No. There are no registration or payment forms on this demo. On a real site you would call a clinic or use a patient portal.
No claim like that is made here. Self-hosting lets an organization keep the public website in its own environment under its own controls; compliance work is still the organization's responsibility.
